cover.coreProposition: Context is disposable but project truth is not: long-horizon agent engineering needs stable candidate identity, separate durable artifact and evidence state, independent acceptance, and explicit freshness invalidation after change.
cover.visualMetaphor: A transient luminous workspace fades away while a durable crystalline project core preserves revision layers and evidence rings; one later change sends a visible freshness ripple through the evidence boundary.
cover.semanticObject: A fading context shell around a durable versioned project core with separate evidence rings and one regression ripple
cover.compositionIntent: Premium 16:9 editorial cover with deep navy space, cyan version layers, violet evidence rings, one restrained amber freshness ripple, glass-like depth, strong central hierarchy, and generous negative space
